observations.value: Decision (accepted Oct 15, 2026): volatile.uuid stays the basis of the SPIFFE ID, but it is not globally unique: an export and import keeps it, on another server and on the same server (two live instances with one uuid, generation and cloud-init instance-id). Hence server_id stays mandatory in the ID (FR-S7); T7 covers both cases; the plugin fails closed when the uuid is found on more than one instance of the allowed projects of a server (new requirement; api_filtering becomes a required extension, with an unfiltered list as fallback if L8 shows a version without it) or on two configured servers. Copies, local or to another server, get a new uuid, generation and cloud-init instance-id (T14 confirmed). Snapshot restore changes only volatile.uuid.generation (FR-S10 confirmed). Move and lxd recover change nothing; a move to another server changes the ID through server_id. Rename changes only volatile.cloud-init.instance-id, which is therefore a consistency hint, not an identity. volatile.base_image never changes (historic claim confirmed). Keys in instance config, the cloud-init ones included, travel with every copy, move and import. Evidence: runs 20261015T090510Z-g-l6-*, 20261015T114139Z-g-l6-same-server-import-lxd5.
